title: Multi-channel Workflow Part 1
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input your protocol parameters above (this protocol performs steps 23‑41.1 of the SOP).

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file and unzip it if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your labware files with a .json extension, if needed.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: In the OT App’s Protocol tab, upload the protocol file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Use the OT App to calibrate your labware, tip rack, and pipette (refer to the support articles for calibration tips).

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the "Run" button in the OT App to start the protocol.
